title: Plan 14 sparse spectrum-tail initialization, matched T720 synthesis A/B
measurement_source_note: The candidate binaries were built from the exact source diff later committed as 1951e833; during capture the Git base reported 2661dbb6 with a dirty worktree. No unrelated source changes were present.

toolchain.runtime_simd: Pulp V3 AVX2/FMA; four f64 lanes

host.affinity: same eight physical CPUs selected by the benchmark harness for q8; q1 controls use its selected physical CPU
host.cpu_psi_at_start_end: avg10=0.00 at initial profiling checkpoint; individual captures also record runqueue wait and sampled frequency

method.timing: reused plans/workspaces; 25 ms calibrated batches; 10 timed batches per process; three interleaved Rust/DUCC process pairs per capture; backend order alternated
method.fixtures: deterministic parity-harness coefficient/map inputs; exact SHA-256 stored per capture
method.setup: plan/workspace setup and first call recorded outside warmed batches
method.scope: whole native synthesis including Legendre recurrence, Fourier spectrum production, inverse FFT and output
